blocks.name: optimal policy and normalization
blocks.raw:
π*(y|x) = (1/Z(x)) · π_ref(y|x) · exp(r(x,y)/β)

Z(x) = Σ_y π_ref(y|x) · exp(r(x,y)/β)

blocks.name: implicit reward
blocks.raw: r(x,y) = β log(π*(y|x)/π_ref(y|x)) + β log Z(x)

blocks.name: substituted preference
blocks.raw: P(y_w ≻ y_l | x) = σ(β log(π*(y_w|x)/π_ref(y_w|x)) - β log(π*(y_l|x)/π_ref(y_l|x)))

blocks.name: fixed reference loss
blocks.raw:
L_DPO(π_θ; π_ref) = - E_{(x,y_w,y_l)~D}[log σ(β log(π_θ(y_w|x)/π_ref(y_w|x))
                      - β log(π_θ(y_l|x)/π_ref(y_l|x)))]

blocks.name: loss gradient
blocks.raw:
∇_θ L_DPO = - β E[σ(r̂_θ(x,y_l)-r̂_θ(x,y_w))
                 · (∇_θ log π_θ(y_w|x)-∇_θ log π_θ(y_l|x))]
